description: Defines UI components for the users table in the system console, including classes for the table and individual user rows, with methods for sorting, visibility, and interactions.

classes.name: UsersTable
classes.description: Represents the users table component in the system console UI, providing methods to interact with table headers, rows, and sorting.

classes.name: UserRow
classes.description: Represents a single user row within the users table, providing methods to access user details and perform actions like opening the action menu.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the users table component is visible on the page.

methods.name: getRowByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user row by its index.

methods.name: getColumnHeader
methods.description: Returns the locator for a specified column header by display name.

methods.name: clickSortOnColumn
methods.description: Clicks on a column header to trigger sorting.

methods.name: sortByColumn
methods.description: Sorts the table by a specified column and returns the new sort direction.

methods.name: waitForLoadingComplete
methods.description: Waits for the loading spinner to disappear and for the table to stabilize.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Simulates clicking on a user row.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the email address from the user row.

methods.name: openActionMenu
methods.description: Opens the action menu for a user and returns the menu object.
